Event-title patterns: 'X 01' (character event), 'X Jealousy', 'X Jealousy (Guy)' (tai-otoko-you: the rival is male, verified from ext_kgr_003/004), 'X Affinity 01' (yuukoudo = Affinity, glossary provisional), 'X End (Male/Female)' (player-gender version), 'X Affinity N Miss M' (hazure = miss variant). Slice 41 continues the same series (Klan) and should use the same wording.
u4323/u4324 'Zentran-Size Tank': the tank Klan uses to return to Zentradi size (zentora-ka); no glossary term (glossary has 'micronize' for the reverse).

u4329 'Deep Akihabara' (shin-Akihabara written with the kanji for deep); u4332 'Folmo' (same katakana as Exsedol Folmo's surname; a shopping spot); u4351 'Sky Gate' (a concert venue in the campus text): not in the glossary.
u4350 'Seidokan' (read as sei-dou-kan): not used anywhere in the campus scripts, reading unverified.
